notes.title: Patch incoming !
notes.content:
A patch will be deployed tonight, to fix java's problem.
You have to install java 64bits (Last version, not necessarily Java 7.)

We are also working on the integration of multiplayer in the game directly.

Thanks for support :)

Stay tuned !
